source.path_rule: All paths in this file are repository-relative. Read every referenced fixture, test, document, and verification command before changing a feature.

features.title: DSN URI connection
features.description: Open a database from one URI DSN. The URI scheme selects the driver, every connection reads and writes datetime values in UTC, and the client plans statements in its own process. The PHP client requires no PDO driver extension, so a PHP without pdo_mysql runs it on SQLite. A MySQL DSN connects with TLS through ssl-mode=VERIFY_IDENTITY and an absolute ssl-ca, which checks the server certificate against the CA and the host name; the PHP and TypeScript clients refuse a parameter outside the set of each scheme.
features.description_ko: 하나의 URI DSN으로 데이터베이스를 연다. URI scheme이 driver를 정하고 모든 연결이 datetime을 UTC로 읽고 쓰며, client는 자기 process에서 statement를 계획한다. PHP client는 PDO driver 확장을 요구하지 않으므로 pdo_mysql이 없는 PHP도 SQLite로 실행한다. MySQL DSN은 ssl-mode=VERIFY_IDENTITY와 절대 경로 ssl-ca로 TLS 연결하며, 이는 server 인증서를 CA와 host 이름에 대조한다. PHP와 TypeScript client는 scheme마다 정한 parameter 밖의 parameter를 거부한다.
state: parse the DSN scheme and parameters
select native driver
load and check the schema manifest
open connection pool with UTC sessions

errors.when: the DSN scheme or a parameter is invalid, the timezone parameter is neither UTC nor +00:00, or the MySQL TLS parameters are not ssl-mode=VERIFY_IDENTITY with an absolute ssl-ca and a host name
the generated models come from another dbspec document set

verification.command: PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo test --manifest-path clients/rust/Cargo.toml --locked --workspace --features "$ORM_RUST_TEST_FEATURES" --test zone --test sqlite_file_name

features.title: Model queries
features.description: Build conditions, joins, relations, columns, subqueries, aggregates, and pages with the generated model methods and read the rows as models and collections.
features.description_ko: 생성된 모델 메서드로 조건, 조인, 관계, 컬럼, 서브쿼리, 집계, 페이지를 만들고 행을 모델과 컬렉션으로 읽는다.
state: build a value-free request and a parameter list
plan once per request shape
run the main and relation statements
assemble models by position

errors.when: the chain is incomplete or the model has no connection outside a transaction
the request shape is invalid
an IN list is empty

features.title: Model writes
features.description: Create, create many, update with optional optimistic locking, save, delete with optional recursive relation deletion, including the duplication assignments of an upsert, and restore a soft-deleted row named by its primary key or one unique key, with new values of its other columns, returning the restored row.
features.description_ko: 생성, 다건 생성, 선택적 낙관적 잠금 갱신, 저장, 선택적 관계 재귀 삭제를 수행하며 upsert의 duplication 할당을 포함한다. primary key나 unique key 하나의 값으로 찾은 soft delete한 행을 다른 컬럼의 새 값과 함께 restore하고 되돌린 행을 반환한다.
state: assign values and timestamps
encrypt AES columns with the current key version
run the write statement
return the stored row
restore a soft-deleted row by its primary key or one unique key

errors.when: an optimistic update matched no row
an insert conflicts with a unique key
a write breaks a foreign key
restore names a key that no row has

features.title: Transactions
features.description: Run a callback in a transaction shared by the current execution flow, with savepoints for nested calls, deadlock retry, isolation, read-only mode, timeoutMs, row locks, named locks, and transaction-local values. A SQLite write transaction takes the write lock at its start and waits for it up to busy_timeout. A test entry point of each client arms a rollback fault: the next rollback of a transaction whose callback failed runs and is reported as FAULT, so the transaction returns ROLLBACK.
features.description_ko: 현재 실행 흐름이 공유하는 트랜잭션에서 콜백을 실행한다. 중첩 호출은 savepoint를 쓰고, 교착 재시도, 격리 수준, 읽기 전용, timeoutMs, 행 잠금, 이름 잠금, 트랜잭션 지역 값을 제공한다. SQLite 쓰기 트랜잭션은 시작할 때 쓰기 잠금을 얻고 busy_timeout까지 잠금을 기다린다. 각 클라이언트의 test entry point는 rollback fault를 설정한다. callback이 실패한 다음 트랜잭션의 rollback은 실행된 뒤 FAULT로 보고되어 트랜잭션이 ROLLBACK을 반환한다.
state: begin or create a savepoint
run models without a connection in the flow transaction
commit or roll back
retry on deadlock

errors.when: a row lock or named lock runs outside a transaction, or the transaction connection is used concurrently
the retries are exhausted
another SQLite connection still holds the lock when busy_timeout ends
the dialect rejects an option
the callback of a transaction or savepoint failed and its rollback failed too; the error keeps both errors
a test fault armed through the test entry point reported the rollback of a transaction whose callback failed as failed after the rollback ran; it is the rollback error of a ROLLBACK error

public_constraints: The chain declares no cancellation operation: a flow cancels through the host language primitive on a connection handle (Go WithContext, TypeScript withSignal, Rust dropping the statement future), and a cancelled statement returns CANCELED.
PHP cancellation is not implemented yet.
The interface manifest prohibits query_cancel, transaction_cancel, and in_flight_cancellation symbols.

features.title: Model generation
features.description: Generate the models from the dbspec document set with the generator of each language. Go and Rust scan the sources and generate the chain methods they call; PHP resolves chains at run time and TypeScript types the scanned chains. With `--check`, the Go, PHP, and TypeScript generators compare the models with the output directory without writing.
features.description_ko: 언어별 생성기로 dbspec document set에서 모델을 만든다. Go와 Rust는 소스를 읽어 호출한 체인 메서드를 만들고, PHP는 실행 시 체인을 해석하며 TypeScript는 읽은 체인에 타입을 붙인다. `--check`를 붙이면 Go, PHP, TypeScript 생성기는 쓰지 않고 모델을 출력 디렉터리와 비교한다.
state: parse the dbspec document set and compute its manifest hash
scan calls
reject names outside the chain rules
write the models

errors.when: a called name does not follow the chain rules or a column name is reserved
a document of the set breaks a dbspec rule

verification.command: go test -v -timeout 0 ./generator -count=1 && cd clients/go/model && go generate ./ && git diff --exit-code -- .

PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo test --manifest-path clients/rust/Cargo.toml --locked --workspace --features "$ORM_RUST_TEST_FEATURES" --test generate && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo test --manifest-path clients/rust/Cargo.toml --locked --workspace --features "$ORM_RUST_TEST_FEATURES" --lib generate::

features.title: Schema definition and migration
features.description: Parse and emit dbspec documents, compute the manifest and schema hashes of a document set, render the DDL of each dialect, introspect a database into a document, diff two schemas into plans and apply them with verification and recovery, and export and import Mermaid diagrams.
features.description_ko: dbspec document를 parse하고 emit하며, document set의 manifest와 schema hash를 계산하고, dialect별 DDL을 렌더링하고, 데이터베이스를 document로 introspect하며, 두 schema의 차이를 plan으로 만들어 검증과 복구를 갖춰 적용하고, Mermaid 다이어그램을 export하고 import한다.
state: parse documents with located diagnostics
validate names, keys, foreign keys, checks and settings
compute the manifest and schema hashes
render statements, plans or Mermaid diagrams
apply plans and verify the introspected schema

errors.when: a document breaks a dbspec rule
a database connection is invalid

features.title: Schema installation
features.description: Install a dbspec document set through a connection: every client renders the statements of its dialect, creates every table when no table of the set exists, changes nothing when every table exists, and fails with CONFIG when only some exist. A process loads the generated code of several document sets, and one connection serves all of them, each request with the model of its manifest hash. addTablesAndColumns upgrades an installed document set by the tables the database lacks and the missing columns of the existing tables that are null or have a default with the plan steps of the dialect, which create each table with its indexes, foreign keys, checks and triggers and replace the audit triggers of each changed table; it leaves the tables of other sets unchanged and returns SCHEMA_DIFFERS before any change for every other difference.
features.description_ko: 연결로 dbspec document set을 설치한다. 모든 client가 자기 dialect의 문장을 렌더링해 set의 table이 하나도 없으면 모두 만들고, 모두 있으면 아무것도 바꾸지 않으며, 일부만 있으면 CONFIG로 실패한다. 한 process가 여러 document set의 generated code를 읽고, 한 연결이 그 모두를 각 요청의 manifest hash에 맞는 model로 처리한다. addTablesAndColumns는 설치한 document set에 database에 없는 table과, 기존 table에 빠진 column 가운데 null이거나 default가 있는 column을 dialect의 plan step으로 더하며, 그 step은 각 table을 index, foreign key, check, trigger와 함께 만들고 바뀐 table의 audit trigger를 바꾼다. 다른 set의 table은 바꾸지 않고, 다른 모든 차이에는 변경 전에 SCHEMA_DIFFERS를 반환한다.
state: render the statements of the dialect
check which tables of the set exist
apply the statements in one transaction where the dialect allows it
change nothing when every table of the set exists
add the missing columns of the existing tables that are null or have a default with the plan steps of the dialect

errors.when: the document set is invalid
only some tables of the set exist, MySQL installs inside a transaction, or MySQL or SQLite adds columns inside a transaction
a request carries a manifest hash that no loaded generated code registered, or generated code holds a manifest text that does not hash to its declared manifest hash
addTablesAndColumns found a difference between the existing tables of the document set and the set other than a missing table or a missing column that is null or has a default

features.description_ko: 값이 없는 request를 manifest로 검증하고 dialect SQL, bind slot, 조립 정보를 client process에서 만든다. 네 planner는 같은 statement를 만든다.
state: validate the request
render the statements
cache the plan by request shape

errors.when: the request shape is invalid
a column is not in the manifest
a function name is unknown

features.title: Composite keys
features.description: Preserve every declared primary and foreign key component in identity, writes, relations, tuple conditions, and pages.
features.description_ko: 선언된 모든 primary key와 foreign key 구성 요소를 식별, 쓰기, 관계, tuple 조건, 페이지에서 유지한다.
state: read every key component
match relations by all components
write by the full key

errors.when: a tuple condition has the wrong width

features.title: Authenticated encryption
features.description: Encode authenticated versioned AES values and blind indexes, read mixed key versions, and rotate every encrypted column of a table in batches.
features.description_ko: 인증과 버전이 있는 AES 값과 blind index를 인코딩하고, 섞인 key version을 읽으며, 테이블의 모든 암호화 컬럼을 배치로 회전한다.
state: encrypt with the current version
decrypt by the stored version
rewrite stale rows in batches

errors.when: a key version is missing
a value cannot be decoded

features.title: Parameter chunking
features.description: Pad relation key lists to size classes, split relation keys and oversized root IN lists at the driver bind limit, merge the results, and reject root shapes that a merge would change.
features.description_ko: 관계 key 목록을 크기 등급으로 채우고, 관계 key와 큰 root IN 목록을 driver bind 한도에서 나누어 결과를 합치며, 병합이 결과를 바꾸는 root 모양은 거부한다.
state: pad key lists
split at the bind limit
remove duplicate IN values
merge rows and sum counts

errors.when: a root shape with order, limit, grouping, or OR cannot be split
an IN list is empty

verification.command: PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo build --manifest-path clients/rust/Cargo.toml --locked -p orm-tests --bin integration && clients/rust/target/debug/integration "$PWD/schema/bench.dbs"

features.title: Constraints and relations
features.description: Keep CHECK constraints, indexes, internal and external foreign keys, soft delete, immutable tables, and relation delete actions in the planner and the migration system.
features.description_ko: CHECK 제약, index, 내부와 외부 foreign key, soft delete, 변경 불가 테이블, 관계 삭제 동작을 planner와 migration 시스템에서 유지한다.
state: read the checks, keys and settings of the document
render constraints and triggers
exclude soft-deleted rows from reads

errors.when: a constraint or setting names an unknown table or column
a write breaks a CHECK constraint
a trigger, such as an immutable or audit trigger, refuses a write, or the driver reports another error that the catalog does not list

features.title: Audit triggers
features.description: The audit setting of a table installs row triggers that copy every inserted and updated row into the declared history table with the operation id that the transaction sets; the setting records every column, or only the columns that an exclude or include list selects, and the history table holds exactly the recorded columns. Every transaction entry point of a client takes the operation id: Go Transaction, PHP transaction and TypeScript transaction through the connection or its context or signal handle, and Rust transaction, transaction_send and transaction_once; a nested transaction takes none. Restoring a soft-deleted row of an audited table is an update that writes the operation id, and the history records it. A transaction that begins without an operation id takes one before its first audited write through utils().setOperation(id); another id is CONFIG, and a savepoint that rolls back restores the id it began with.
features.description_ko: 테이블의 audit 설정은 행 trigger를 설치해, 삽입·갱신된 모든 행을 트랜잭션이 정한 작업 id와 함께 선언한 history 테이블에 복사한다. 설정은 모든 column을, 또는 exclude나 include 목록이 고른 column만 기록하며, history 테이블은 기록하는 column만 가진다. 클라이언트의 모든 트랜잭션 진입점이 작업 id를 받는다: 연결이나 그 context, signal handle을 통한 Go Transaction, PHP transaction, TypeScript transaction, 그리고 Rust transaction, transaction_send, transaction_once다. 중첩 트랜잭션은 받지 않는다. 감사 대상 테이블에서 soft delete한 행을 restore하는 것은 작업 id를 쓰는 update이며, history가 이를 기록한다. 작업 id 없이 시작한 트랜잭션은 첫 감사 대상 write 전에 utils().setOperation(id)로 id를 받는다. 다른 id는 CONFIG이고, rollback한 savepoint는 시작할 때의 id로 되돌린다.
state: render the audit triggers with the audited table
set the operation id on every transaction entry point
copy each changed row into the history table
restore a soft-deleted row with an update that the history records
set the operation id inside a running transaction

errors.when: an audit setting names an unknown history table, a column that does not match, a list column that is unknown, repeats or is the operation column, or both an exclude and an include list

features.title: Common interface verification
features.description: Every client exposes the public symbols declared in contracts/interfaces.json. Each language extracts its declarations from real syntax trees without running model code, and the comparator fails when a symbol, field, return, or error differs from the common interface.
features.description_ko: 모든 클라이언트는 contracts/interfaces.json에 선언한 공개 심볼을 노출한다. 각 언어는 모델 코드를 실행하지 않고 실제 구문 트리에서 선언을 뽑고, 비교 도구는 심볼, 필드, 반환, 오류가 공통 인터페이스와 다르면 실패한다.
state: extract the declarations of each language
compare them with the common interface
fail on any difference

errors.when: a language's extracted declarations differ from the manifest, or a component diagram differs from the manifest

features.title: Hot-path performance standard
features.description: The Go and PHP clients keep hot-path latency within a measured ratio of the raw driver on the seeded MySQL bench database, and make perf-check fails when a workload exceeds its recorded bound. The Rust bench harness measures without an enforced bound, and the TypeScript standard is not built.
features.description_ko: Go와 PHP 클라이언트는 seed한 MySQL 벤치 데이터베이스에서 hot-path 지연 시간을 순수 드라이버와의 비율 안에서 유지하며, make perf-check는 작업량이 기록한 상한을 넘으면 실패한다. Rust 벤치 도구는 상한 없이 측정만 하고 TypeScript 기준은 만들지 않았다.
state: seed the bench database
alternate native and client pairs
compare each ratio with its recorded bound

errors.when: a workload's client/native ratio exceeds its recorded bound; the runner prints the measured pair and the bound

features.title: Conformance verification
features.description: Run the same model chains in Go, PHP, Rust, and TypeScript on MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQLite and compare the statements and results with the recorded vectors.
features.description_ko: 같은 모델 체인을 Go, PHP, Rust, TypeScript에서 MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite로 실행하고 statement와 결과를 기록된 벡터와 비교한다.
state: run every runner
normalize sequence values, clocks, and ciphertext
compare with the vectors of the database

errors.when: a runner cannot connect or another run holds the lock

features.title: Rust catalog connection
features.description: With the live-db feature, orm-build opens a catalog connection from one DSN, reads table metadata and bounded table pages, runs dialect-parsed read-only queries, and inserts, updates and deletes rows with verified snapshots. Only the Rust client provides it.
features.description_ko: live-db feature가 켜진 orm-build는 하나의 DSN으로 catalog 연결을 열고, table metadata와 제한된 table page를 읽고, dialect로 parse한 read-only query를 실행하며, 검증된 snapshot으로 row를 insert, update, delete한다. Rust client만 제공한다.
state: connect without creating a missing SQLite file
read metadata and pages through bound catalog names
run read-only statements under validated budgets
change rows in a transaction that compares and verifies snapshots

errors.when: the DSN, the table reference or a limit is invalid, or a read-only statement writes
